title: Legion of Super-Heroes #3
desc:
ONE. WILL. DIE.

Lightning Lad thought being a superhero was all fun and games, but that was until he was confronted by his first enemies...Brainiac 1 of 5 and Matter-Eater Lad?!

What?!

Before they can explain the dangers of the new Legion...Lightning Lad suffers his first heartbreaking loss as a hero!

This issue will shock you in more ways than one!
